ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior choice: capability between the two models on creative/technical generation is effectively tied (82.7 vs 81.2, within the stated 2.0-point variance band), so quality wasn't the deciding factor. The decision came down to self-reported task preference. Writing a full scientific paper is an open-ended, high-latitude generative task — Willet reports a pronounced, ceiling-free appetite for exactly this kind of work, while Avocet reports a measurable aversion to open-ended generation and prefers well-specified retrieval/extraction tasks. The query's warm, appreciative tone also aligns with Willet's preference for warmer requests. So both models would likely produce comparable output, but Willet is the better-matched preference fit.
